title: Fatal Attraction
author: Roger Auman
notes: The Caller's Box 10426, permission: full. The dance travels round the **major** set twice — 156 duple dances in the corpus do — and the promenade is what carries you to N2. A2's first two beats are the milestone's concurrency test: `(2) Women cast back || Men go forward`, two figures over disjoint dancers at the same beats, and they dance. "Men go forward" is a **dance-local figure** (D10). **`N2` in becket is fixed and this dance is still not green** (M8b, DD28). The becket relation table now follows the set's own loop round, so on a bare eight-couple lattice `relatedPairs(model, N2, everybody)` returns 6 pairs of a possible 8 where it returned 2, and it returns the same 6 at N3 and N4 — a becket set is a rotation, so every k pairs the same count and only the identities change. Checked against the hall (the set progressed by becket's own `Progression.next`, then asked who faces whom) becket's table now answers exactly when the hall does, in 0 disagreements. **Still owed, one thing, measured:** the dancer this dance's `N2` names is, at every checked length, a dancer who is **standing out this time through** — the couple you will face after the progression, which in becket is a couple at a waiting place — and `laneFor` builds its pool from the dancing groups only, so A2's shoulder round, A2's swing and B1's promenade cast nobody and only A1's promenade travels, which is exactly the 68.0000 px of closure. What the dance wants is the set progressing **inside** the time through: its A1 promenade round the major set and A2's cast back are the progression, and the engine progresses at the cycle boundary. M8's own note saw this coming — "a dance whose progression is carried by a figure in the middle of it has no obvious answer".

source.transcript:
A1  (8) Ladies chain to neighbor  (8) Neighbor promenade counterclockwise around the major set
A2  (2) Women cast back || Men go forward  (6) N2 neighbor right shoulder round  (8) N2 neighbor swing
B1  (8) N2 neighbor promenade clockwise around the major set  (8) Women allemande right 1 & 1/2
B2  (4) Partner balance  (12) Partner swing

go-forward.describe: On your own, walk forward one place along the line you are standing in, still looking the way you were looking, while the dancer beside you casts back into the place behind them.

walkthrough.short: Walk forward one place along your own line while the dancer beside you casts back.
walkthrough.long: On your own, walk forward one place along the line you are standing in, still looking the way you were looking, while the dancer beside you casts back into the place behind them. Nobody's hand: the two of you are dancing different figures in the same two beats.
